note: This metric is not age-standardized, so differences between countries partly reflect differences in their age structure.
title: Share of men aged 15–49 with depression
subtitle: Estimated share of men aged 15–49 who have [depression](#dod:depressive_disorders), whether or not they are diagnosed, based on representative surveys, medical data, and statistical modeling. Prevalence is measured as the share experiencing depression at a given point in time. It does not measure lifetime prevalence.
